name: ami-contact-list-builder
description: Guides architects through evidence-based email review to build a clean, segmented contact list for Sunshine Island CRM.

interface.shortDescription: Turn email history into a reviewed, CRM-ready contact list.
interface.longDescription: A guided AMI workflow for architects. It asks simple setup questions, runs a small pilot, reviews message-level professional evidence, rejects keyword-only false positives, groups contacts for easier review, suggests AMI relationship segments, applies optional user-approved project or client-type tags, matches likely duplicate identities, formats phone numbers, and prepares a reviewed workbook and CSV for Sunshine Island CRM.
capabilities: Optional project and client niche tagging
defaultPrompt: Use $ami-contact-list-builder to build a reviewed contact list from my email history for Sunshine Island CRM.
